verifications.claim: Born Again Season 2 premieres on Disney+ on March 24, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the show is returning for a second season on March 24." (R1); "Air Date: Mar 24, 2026" (R4); "Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 premieres Tuesday, March 24 on Disney+" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the premiere date as March 24 (2026 implied by context in R1/R6, explicit in R4) on Disney+.

verifications.claim: Born Again Season 2 follows Wilson Fisk as mayor of New York City in a post-martial law environment.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Fisk, now the mayor of New York City, institute martial law and outlaw vigilantism. This tees up a sophomore season" (R5); "Wilson Fisk – now Mayor of New York City – hunting down Daredevil" (R6); "Wilson Fisk's ... rise to mayor" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Fisk as mayor instituting martial law at end of season 1, setting up season 2 in that environment.
